checks.evidence: The close view preserves a long fox muzzle, paired eyes, upright ears, dark nose, ivory cheeks and the nine-tail crown without blur or melted features.
Chest and cheek fur break the silhouette while dense strand-scale normal relief follows the body and each tail length; ivory tips remain individually readable under key and rim light.
The GLB contains one material with 4096x4096 base-color, normal and packed metallic/roughness PNG textures; roughness response separates fur, nose, eyes, ears and claws.

Final models/web.glb retains 91,600 triangles and byte-identical 4096x4096 base-color, normal, and metallic/roughness images from the accepted Rodin source. Release frames at normal view and constrained close zoom preserve the muzzle, wet nose, eye/ear contrast, directional body fur, tail strand relief and ivory tips.
notes: Rigging reorganized mesh buffers but did not reduce triangle count or replace PBR images; final identity and surface retention were rechecked visually.
